semantic_accounting.definition: Human semantic completeness requires complete captured semantics with no retained meaningful source ambiguity. The automated Extract flag is reported separately; reviewed source limitations may exist without parser warnings.

collection.counting_note: Failed candidate attempts are separate from rejected validation targets. All500 distinct usable local identities belong to the target; no extra capture filled the final9-document wave.

uniform_validation.source_review_basis: All500 current-parser source reviews remain valid: frozen approved output/RAW hashes exactly match every forced final regeneration and independent audit.

latest_wave_generic_repairs.root_cause: First-colon/80-character splitting treats explanatory examples inside parentheses as entered values. Balanced delimiter lookup preserves actual long terminal labels, with null values and source offsets.

A footnote counter before a literal blank prevents placeholder-prefix isolation, absorbing following confirmation prose into value_text. Recognize the referenced blank prefix while preserving the full source sentence.

Unfamiliar labels and punctuation in slash-separated prompts interrupt known-name runs, including simple physical form cells. Explicit terminal prompts in bounded input runs or simple non-header form cells retain unknown field semantics and null values; headings, prose and outside-form cells remain guarded.

A source closing lacks a signer name and is followed by a template issuer/header with one literal blank and several actual colon inputs. Blank-only completion lookahead misses the boundary and a template institution is misclassified as the source signer.

Explicit template codes with colon/alphanumeric counters inside physical header tables were not form boundaries. Reuse generic caption recognition with first-row attachment-note evidence, preserving physical table geometry and source text under a form header.

Presentation grid lineage was erased when flattening source columns, preventing unfamiliar literal prompts from being represented. Preserve private grid provenance and confirm paired colon prompts only in active form scopes, using unknown semantics/null values.

A source-emphasized uppercase cover has a mixed-case parenthetical reporting-period qualifier and was left outside form scope. Count actual completion evidence once per annex and retain the qualified cover plus preceding blank header table, without treating ordinary published annex prose as a form.

Repeated source template issuers, displayed titles and actual input blanks require new uncoded form scopes. Preserve numbered source case variants and institutional placeholders; share a single title predicate so Đơn vị/Đơn giản compounds cannot end the header region or become application titles.
Repeated-letterhead detection must not split the first header of an explicit source template caption into an additional uncoded form. Require preceding current-form content.

Bộ followed by a document-set noun is a document heading, not a ministry. Share source noun-compound title evidence; institutional header placeholders require actual institutional wording rather than any uppercase line.
A literal slash-prefixed uppercase document-number suffix in a template header must remain a form number without an invented prefix; it must not replace the displayed title.

table_performance.repair: Reusable source-cell and row/column indexes plus active merged-cell rectangles replace repeated full-table scans. Sparse code-row/header rules preserve actual semantics; no size-specific skipping.
table_performance.verification: Focused performance regressions, actual large capture regeneration/audit and final full640 suite; see Wave21 table evidence and final uniform cache.

retained: Incomplete quotation punctuation and duplicate legal counters are preserved literally.
Image-only content is retained without fabricated OCR.
Table axes remain unknown/partial when source markup does not establish safe associations.
Hidden or unresolved document relationships are retained without invented links.
Referenced attached bodies absent from captured HTML remain source ambiguities, including expansion positions324and348.
Incomplete source dates and absent signer names remain incomplete.
